The Laws of Manu in twelve chapters (Sanskrit)

मनुः (by tradition)

The Sanskrit text of the Manusmṛti, the best known of the Dharmaśāstras, in its twelve chapters, from creation and the duties of the stages of life to law, penance and liberation.
